discharge_summary: Patient is medically stable following ischemic stroke but requires continued rehabilitation and discharge education.

free_text_notes.case_manager_note: No reliable caregiver is available. Outpatient therapy has not been arranged and stroke education remains incomplete.

distractors: The patient had a cataract removed from one eye two years ago. The result was successful. Vision in both eyes is stable and this has no current clinical significance.
The patient reports a mild seasonal allergy that is well controlled with an over-the-counter antihistamine. This was noted and confirmed to have no interaction with current medications.
